          value.st_ctime_ns,value.st_nlink,getattr(value,'st_file_attributes',0))
 def cross_api(value):
  return (value.st_dev,value.st_ino,stat.S_IFMT(value.st_mode),value.st_size,value.st_mtime_ns,value.st_nlink)
